headline: Autonomous product reset: measure real activation, secure local hosts, and earn the first repeat use before scaling acquisition.
summary: The owner delegated CEO priorities and agent allocation on September 14. The team now owns the work queue, targets, verification and reporting. Owner actions are limited to specific business authority or access decisions below; routine design and engineering will continue independently.

Measured baseline is incomplete. The live HQ API still returns July 14. A September 14 aggregate read of a locally configured database found 111 account rows, no registrations in the last 30 days, no upcoming published sessions in the next seven days and no recorded attended reflections. That connection is not verified as production and test/staff exclusions are unavailable. These are not 111 real users. Current production users, active supply and settled revenue remain unknown.

Targets for September 21: 25 new real adult accounts, 12 activated members, 3 committed hosts, 6 real sessions and 6 first attendances. October 14 base plan: 200 new accounts, 100 activated members, 10 recurring hosts and 48 first attendances; 1,000 registrations is the stretch target. At assumed 10% visitor-to-signup conversion the stretch needs 10,000 qualified visits, and the attendance scenario needs at least 300 accepted places. No measured channel currently proves that reach. Targets are not forecasts or achieved results.

Revenue sequence: prove recurring useful activities, interview people after real use, and test the existing Plus value only after final pricing/billing authorization. The 30-day evidence target is ten voluntary value interviews and three explicit purchase-intent statements; a settled first payment is conditional on approval and real demand. Purchase intent is not revenue. Default new cash spend is zero, with no paid ads or tool purchases.

Completed in this work cycle: HQ now prioritizes fresh dated reports and owner decisions, archives July claims and labels unavailable approvals honestly. The approved landing is on local main, and a new anonymous landing-page-load counter closes the missing top-funnel signal without tracking demo choices or unique people. A five-organization host pilot packet is ready for review. These product/HQ code changes are local, not deployed.

Operating model: one coordinator assigns up to three independent specialist tasks, verifies each completed slice and records local commits. The new Windows recurring runner is prepared with isolated work, overlap protection, time limits and failure stopping; an authenticated read-only CLI smoke passed. Schedule activation and the first real cycle are still being verified, so no claim of 24/7 running is made in this snapshot. Local automation requires an awake, logged-in computer, network and available ChatGPT usage.

Reporting access is blocked: local HQ publishing/decision credentials are missing and the Vercel login is expired. This report is a local repository snapshot until authenticated API publication succeeds. The live website will continue showing the old report until that access is restored. The team continues useful local work; there is no substitute for a verified live publish.

Next priority: patch the audited Next.js dependency before further feature work; then verify the create-invite-request-accept-attend path using isolated fixtures and simplify first-use discovery/signup. Prepare host supply and a privacy-safe invitation loop. Preserve pending decisions under stable IDs and replan from measured outcomes.

directions.title: Restore live HQ reporting and decision access
directions.detail: The local reporting credentials are absent and Vercel reports an invalid login. This prevents publishing new reports to live HQ and reading your saved approval responses. The agent cannot sign into your provider account for you. This local snapshot is reviewable at /hq.html; the remote HQ still has July's report.
directions.recommendation: Complete vercel login on this computer, then tell the team authentication is restored. The team can retrieve the existing scoped reporting configuration and verify an authenticated publish/readback. Alternative: provision the existing STANDUP_AGENT_SECRET for report publishing and SOCIAL_AGENT_SECRET for decision reads in the ignored .env.studio.local file through your secure environment workflow. Never paste secret values into HQ or chat. Until restored, local work and local reports continue.

directions.title: Approve a small Bucharest host-validation pilot
directions.detail: Ready packet: /operations/host-pilot-2026-09-14.html. Five organizations were checked on their official sites: Runners of Bucharest, F45 Bucharest North, Padel One, PadelMania and Bucharest Running Club. The packet contains the exact Romanian message, tailored opening lines and host/session checklist. No messages have been sent and no host is committed. This is a 14-day research pilot, not a final launch-country decision.
directions.recommendation: Approve Bucharest as the pilot hypothesis and personally send one tailored inquiry to each of the five organizations, with at most one follow-up after five business days if unanswered. Target five inquiries by day 3, two substantive conversations by day 7, one committed host and feasible session plan by day 14. A named real safety/operator contact is required before any session. Alternatives: name a city where you have a reliable local operator, or defer real outreach. Approval does not permit spending, bookings, contracts, public campaigns or agent-operated account messages.

directions.title: Review the landing and HQ; release waits for framework patch
directions.detail: Ready for review: local main through d58c0e5 includes the approved landing (7fe07ad), HQ freshness and decision reporting, the host-pilot review page and anonymous landing-page-load measurement. Validation: 1,189 web tests passed with 14 opt-in skips; the additional stalled-API regression passed in all 7 focused HQ tests. Web typecheck, production build and local landing/HQ browser checks passed. Lint has zero errors and four existing warnings. No database migration or billing activation is included. The isolated dependency audit subsequently flagged critical Next.js advisories. A framework patch and fresh verification now precede release; d58c0e5 is reviewable, but not the final release candidate.
directions.recommendation: Review the local landing and HQ packet now. The team will prepare the framework patch, passing checks and exact replacement release commit before requesting production deployment. No deployment is authorized by this pending card.
